peopleAlsoAsk.question: What bacteria has a double zone of hemolysis?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Clostridium perfringens is a spore-forming bacterium found in dirt and soil that forms a unique double zone of hemolysis when plated on blood agar. As an obligate anaerobe, it is known for causing two main diseases: a soft tissue infection called gas gangrene (clostridial myonecrosis) and a type of food poisoning.
